skill.name: Gesture + voice remote
skill.description: Remote control by voice (priority) and gesture. A 'when listen' block hears voice commands (forward / back / left / right / strafe left|right / sit / stand / come) and they override gestures. Gestures when nobody speaks: palm=forward, thumb-up=stand, thumb-down=back, point-left/right=turn, victory=strafe left, love=strafe right, fist=sit, wave=come. Faces the user when idle.

fields.TEXT: I'm ready! Show a gesture or tell me what to do.
